secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API Key — Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Your apps > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase Auth Domain — usually <projectId>.firebaseapp.com, from the same Web app config page

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID — Firebase Console > Project Settings > General

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase Storage Bucket — usually <projectId>.appspot.com, from the Web app config page

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Messaging Sender ID — from the Web app config page in Firebase Console

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase App ID — from the Web app config page in Firebase Console
